result.instructions: Tools for Teachable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which students are enrolled in our onboarding course, and how far have they got?"; "Show me the sales transactions from last week, including refunds."; "Enroll the user with ID 4821 in the spring cohort course.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Teachable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run teachable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run teachable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run teachable_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. teachable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: teachable_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the courses at your school, with name, publish state and author. Good first call to find course ids. Teachable API: GET /v1/courses.

is_published.description: true = published courses only, false = unpublished only.

author_bio_id.description: Filter by course author bio ID.

created_at.description: Courses created at this date and time.

tools.name: teachable_get_course
tools.title: Get course
tools.description: Fetch one course by ID, with its lectures and sections. Teachable API: GET /v1/courses/{course_id}.

tools.name: teachable_list_course_enrollments
tools.title: List course enrollments
tools.description: List the active students enrolled in one course, with their progress. Filter by enrolment date. Teachable API: GET /v1/courses/{course_id}/enrollments.

enrolled_in_after.description: Only students enrolled after this date and time.

enrolled_in_before.description: Only students enrolled before this date and time.

tools.name: teachable_get_course_progress
tools.title: Get student course progress
tools.description: Fetch one student's progress through one course: completed lectures and sections. Teachable API: GET /v1/courses/{course_id}/progress.

tools.name: teachable_get_lecture
tools.title: Get lecture
tools.description: Fetch the content of one lecture in a course: text, attachments and video metadata. Teachable API: GET /v1/courses/{course_id}/lectures/{lecture_id}.

tools.name: teachable_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (students, owners, affiliates) of your school. Filter by email. Teachable API: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: teachable_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Fetch one user by ID, with their role, sign-in details and course enrollments. Teachable API: GET /v1/users/{user_id}.

tools.name: teachable_list_pricing_plans
tools.title: List pricing plans
tools.description: List the pricing plans at your school. Teachable API: GET /v1/pricing_plans.

tools.name: teachable_get_pricing_plan
tools.title: Get pricing plan
tools.description: Fetch one pricing plan by ID. Only course pricing plans are supported. Teachable API: GET /v1/pricing_plans/{pricing_plan_id}.

tools.name: teachable_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List sales transactions at your school. New sales can take up to two minutes to appear. Teachable API: GET /v1/transactions.

user_id.description: Only transactions of this user ID.

affiliate_id.description: Only transactions from this affiliate ID.

course_id.description: Only transactions for this course ID.

pricing_plan_id.description: Only transactions for this pricing plan ID.

tools.name: teachable_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured for your school. Teachable API: GET /v1/webhooks.

tools.name: teachable_list_webhook_events
tools.title: List webhook deliveries
tools.description: List the delivery attempts of one webhook, with HTTP status codes. Use it to find failing deliveries. Teachable API: GET /v1/webhooks/{webhook_id}/events.

response_http_status_gte.description: Only responses with HTTP status at or above this value.

response_http_status_lte.description: Only responses with HTTP status at or below this value.

created_after.description: Only deliveries created after this date and time.

created_before.description: Only deliveries created before this date and time.

tools.name: teachable_enroll_user
tools.title: Enroll user in course
tools.description: Enroll an existing user in a course. The student gets access to the course at once. Teachable API: POST /v1/enroll.

tools.name: teachable_unenroll_user
tools.title: Unenroll user from course
tools.description: Remove a user's access to a course. The student loses access at once. Use only when the user asked for it. Teachable API: POST /v1/unenroll.

tools.name: teachable_update_user
tools.title: Update user name or source
tools.description: Change a user's name or signup source (src). No other profile field can be changed. Teachable API: PATCH /v1/users/{user_id}.

src.description: New signup source value for the user.

prompts.title: Get started with Teachable
prompts.description: What you can do with Teachable here, with example requests to try.
